title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page works out the group theory of the extended Teichmüller group of type (1,1) and how it relates to types (0,3) and (0,4).

**The groups.** The group 𝔊 = ⟨ρ,σ,τ' | ρ^6=σ^4=τ'^2=1, ρ^3=σ^2, τ'ρτ'=ρ^{-1}, τ'στ'=σ^{-1}⟩ is GL(2,Z), the extended mapping class group of the once-punctured torus (orientation-reversing classes included).
- 𝔊^+ = ⟨ρ,σ⟩ = SL(2,Z) = Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6, with σ of order 4, ρ of order 6 and ρ^3=σ^2=-1.
- In matrices: σ=[[0,-1],[1,0]], ρ=[[0,-1],[1,1]], τ'=[[0,1],[1,0]].
- μ={±1} is the centre, i.e. the elliptic (hyperelliptic) involution.
- He also introduces τ = στ' = τ'σ^{-1} = diag(-1,1), which is again an involution.

**Top square.** It relates this to genus 0.
- 𝔊_{0,3} → T_{0,3} = 𝔊_{0,3}/𝔊^{+!}_{0,3} ≅ S_3 × μ_τ: permutations of the three points times orientation.
- 𝔊 → T̃_{0,3} = 𝔊/(𝔊^{!+})_0, a central extension by μ.
- Here 𝔊^{!+} = Π is the level-2 congruence subgroup Γ(2) ⊂ SL(2,Z), of index 6, with Π = μ × Π_0.
- Π_0 is a free group of rank 2 (the fundamental group of P^1 − {0,1,∞}), generated by λ_0, λ_1, λ_∞, with λ_i = −l_i.
- He records the orders: 𝔊^+/Π_0 has order 12 and is the dicyclic group Dic_3 = Z/3 ⋊ Z/4 (σρσ^{-1}=ρ^{-1}). 𝔊/Π_0 has order 24, with τ fixing ρ and inverting σ.
- Thus 𝔊/Π_0 → S_3 × Z/2 has kernel μ. This expresses the level-2 identification M_{1,1}[2] ≅ M_{0,4} ≅ P^1 − {0,1,∞}, with S_3 acting on the three cusps.

**Diagram (I), 'position relative de L_ρ et L_σ'.** This is the subgroup lattice around the two elliptic points of the upper half-plane.
- L_σ = ⟨σ⟩ (order 4) and L_ρ = ⟨ρ⟩ (order 6) are their stabilisers in SL(2,Z), meeting in μ.
- D_σ (order 8) and D_ρ (order 12) are the dihedral stabilisers in GL(2,Z), meeting in D_τ' = μ × μ_τ' (order 4).
- This is the amalgam picture GL(2,Z) = D_4 *_{D_2} D_6, SL(2,Z) = Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6, with the indices 2, 3, 6 marked.
- A second cube shows the images of these subgroups in the order-24 quotient 𝔊/Π_0 and in 𝔊^+/Π_0.

**Diagram (II).** This is the level-2 lattice:
- 𝔊^! = Π^!_0 (≅ μ × Π^!_0, kernel of GL(2,Z) → GL(2,F_2) ≅ S_3, index 6);
- 𝔊^!_0 = Π' ⊃ μ_τ;
- 𝔊^{!+} = Π = μ × Π_0;
- Π_0;
- D_2 = μ × μ_τ.

**Remaining notes.** He records the extra automorphism of SL(2,Z) given by ρ ↦ ρ, σ ↦ −σ. A faded pencil sketch gives the parallel lattice of moduli stacks M, M^+, M^!, M^{!+} and their 0-dimensional strata (D_0, L_0 over Π and 𝔊), i.e. the stack-level counterpart.

**Purpose.** This is bookkeeping of the low-dimensional Teichmüller tower (levels (0,3), (0,4), (1,1)), with orientation reversal and the elliptic points made explicit, in preparation for the Galois/Teichmüller programme of the Esquisse.
errors: The second presentation, with τ = στ' and τ(ρ)=ρ^{-1} (partly struck out on the page), is wrong in GL(2,Z). Since τ=diag(-1,1), τρτ = [[0,1],[-1,1]] ≠ ρ^{-1}; in fact τ(ρ) = σρ^{-1}σ^{-1}. The relation τ(ρ)=ρ, together with σ(ρ)=ρ^{-1}, holds only in the quotient 𝔊/Π_0, which is what Grothendieck correctly writes further down.
Some index labels in cube (I) are hard to read and look inconsistent with the orders. For example μ ⊂ L_σ has index 2, not 3, while μ ⊂ L_ρ has index 3.

ideas.what: GL(2,Z) presented as the extended mapping class group of type (1,1); SL(2,Z) = Z/4 *_{Z/2} Z/6 and GL(2,Z) = D_4 *_{D_2} D_6 via the stabilisers of the elliptic points
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses SL2(Z), the elliptic points and the Teichmüller tower, but not this explicit lattice

ideas.modern_name: Level-2 structures; M_{1,1}[2] ≅ M_{0,4}; Legendre family

ideas.where_published: Esquisse mentions the (0,4) and (1,1) levels and their relation

ideas.what: Relating the extended (0,3) Teichmüller group (S_3 × orientation) to the (1,1) group through the order-24 quotient
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984), in general terms

ideas.what: The automorphism ρ ↦ ρ, σ ↦ −σ of SL2(Z) (twist by a character into the centre)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is careful bookkeeping of standard facts about GL(2,Z), SL(2,Z), Γ(2) and their finite quotients, organised in Grothendieck's Teichmüller-tower notation (orientation, elliptic points, level 2). It is historically interesting as working material for the Esquisse, but contains no new result or unexplored connection.
transcription_corrections: The NB line reads 'τ = στ' = τ'σ^{-1}' (with a struck-out symbol), not 'σ\tau\tau''.
In the second presentation τ(ρ) is written with ρ^{-1} partly struck out, and τ(σ)=σ^{-1} is followed by a scribble; these relations are struck through or uncertain on the page.
'𝔊_+' at left of the second row is the bold 𝔊 (the full group), mapping to T̃_{0,3} = 𝔊/(𝔊^{!+})_0.
The order-24 group relation 'σ(ρ)=ρ^{-1}' is part of the 𝔊/Π_0 presentation.
